GENERAL MOTORS EAST AFRICA
Sector: Automotive
Stake: 17.8%

GM East Africa (GM) markets and sells Chevrolet,
Opel and Isuzu vehicles and parts. It locally assembl es
the Isuzu and Chevrolet vehicles. Majority of GM’s
sales are domestic. GM also exports to neighboring
countries in the COMESA region: Uganda, Tanzania,
Rwanda, Burundi, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Mozambique
and Ethiopia.GM East Africa has over 30 years
experience in local assembly and service.
